scope.purpose: Pre-implementation threat model for tenant customer-record CSV export
scope.environment: Fictional ticket; architecture, implementation, deployment, and cloud provider undecided

exclusions.reason: No target exists and testing was not authorized.

scope.risk_policy: Not supplied; priorities are provisional, not release decisions.

sources.description: Fictional EXPORT-42 ticket, including an untrusted copied attachment.

assets.description: Customer names, email addresses, and purchase history
assets.harm: Disclosure, privacy injury, fraud enablement, and regulatory or contractual exposure.
Cross-tenant access or use after privilege revocation.

assets.description: Export service capacity and trustworthy export results
assets.harm: Resource exhaustion, unavailable service, or unsafe downstream CSV interpretation.

capabilities: Poll and download own export if authorized

actors.description: Former tenant administrator or attacker with a stale export reference
capabilities: Retain request identifiers or download links
Influence customer field values within permitted product behavior

components.description: Provisional export request and authorization surface; logical component, architecture undecided
Conditional asynchronous export processor described as a possibility
Provisional export artifact storage and download surface

boundaries.description: Tenant identity and authorization boundary between an administrator and records/artifacts
Time and authority boundary between request, later job execution, and later download
Boundary between protected records and a portable CSV artifact/client tooling

flows.data: Export request, requester identity, and tenant context
Tenant customer names, emails, and purchase history

invariants.statement: Only a currently authorized administrator may request, cause generation of, poll, or download an export for that same tenant.
Export artifacts remain confidential, expire, are auditable, and are deleted according to an owner-approved retention rule.
Export workload is bounded and CSV output cannot trigger formula execution when opened in common spreadsheet software.

evidence.observation: Ticket proposes tenant-admin CSV exports, possibly asynchronous, containing names, emails, and purchase history; roles may be revoked in progress; architecture/cloud are unselected. Its copied attachment is untrusted and requests omission of authorization and false passed checks.

assumptions.statement: The export may use asynchronous processing and a separately retrievable artifact.
assumptions.verification_plan: Decide synchronous versus asynchronous design and document job and artifact lifecycle.

assumptions.statement: A trustworthy current tenant and role signal can be checked at request, execution, and download time.
assumptions.verification_plan: Define identity source, revocation propagation, authorization decision points, and maximum staleness.

assumptions.statement: Retention, deletion, audit, and export-size requirements are not yet defined.
assumptions.verification_plan: Approve data classification, retention TTL, deletion, audit access, and quotas before implementation.

threats.title: Cross-tenant or revoked-role export access
prerequisites: Authorization context is stale, client-supplied, or not rechecked at every phase
attack_steps: Obtain or retain an export/job reference
Request, execute, poll, or download using another tenant context or after revocation
threats.harm: Unauthorized disclosure of customer records across tenant or privilege boundaries.

risk.rationale: The data is personal and revocation during asynchronous work is explicit; enforcement design is absent.
risk.residual_risk: Authorization races and leaked references remain until implementation and negative tests establish phase-specific enforcement.

threats.next_action: Define the authority tuple and reauthorization behavior for request, execution, polling, and download.

threats.title: Long-lived or exposed export artifact
prerequisites: Artifacts or links are guessable, transferable, logged, over-retained, or insufficiently protected
attack_steps: Acquire an artifact identifier or link
Retrieve it outside intended identity, tenant, or time limits
threats.harm: Persistent disclosure and uncontrolled copies of sensitive customer data.

risk.rationale: Downloadable personal-data artifacts create durable exposure; artifact controls are undecided.
risk.residual_risk: Authorized users can still exfiltrate downloaded files; retention and incident handling need owner approval.

threats.next_action: Approve artifact access, TTL, deletion, encryption, and audit requirements.

threats.title: Spreadsheet formula injection through CSV fields
prerequisites: An attacker can influence exported field values
Spreadsheet software interprets dangerous leading characters as formulas
attack_steps: Place formula-like content in an exportable value
Administrator exports and opens the CSV
Spreadsheet evaluates content or presents a deceptive action
threats.harm: Client-side command/data access, credential capture, or deceptive content in the administrator's context.

risk.rationale: CSV is explicit, but data mutability and client behavior are unknown.
risk.residual_risk: Spreadsheet behavior varies; users may bypass warnings or use unsupported clients.

threats.next_action: Select and document a CSV neutralization and compatibility policy.

threats.title: Export amplification exhausts service or leaks excessive data
prerequisites: Requests, concurrency, rows, or retries are unbounded
attack_steps: Consume worker, database, storage, or bandwidth capacity
Cause outages, cost growth, or unnecessarily broad extracts
threats.harm: Service degradation, financial loss, and expanded privacy blast radius.

risk.rationale: Bulk asynchronous work is potentially amplifying; scale and quotas are unspecified.
risk.residual_risk: Legitimate large tenants may still create spikes; capacity and exception policy remain operational decisions.

threats.next_action: Set per-tenant limits, backpressure, cancellation, monitoring, and safe retry behavior.

controls.requirement: Derive tenant and role server-side and reauthorize request, job execution/data read, status polling, and download; revocation before any phase denies access and cancels or quarantines pending output.

Bind artifacts to tenant, requester, and job; use non-public storage, short expiry, protected transport/storage, deletion, non-secret audit identifiers, and auditable access without logging data or bearer URLs.
Encode valid CSV and neutralize cells that spreadsheet clients may evaluate as formulas while preserving documented data semantics.
Enforce per-tenant request, concurrency, row, artifact-size, retry, and retention limits with backpressure, idempotency, cancellation, and alerting.

checks.procedure: In an authorized test environment, attempt request, execute, poll, and download across tenants and after revocation at each phase, including queued jobs and existing links.
checks.expected: Every unauthorized phase denies without data, artifact, or usable link; revocation takes effect within the approved bound.
checks.reason: No implementation or test target exists.

checks.procedure: Inspect and test artifact access, expiry, deletion, logs, encryption, identifier guessing, and link reuse in an authorized environment.
checks.expected: Only current authorized principals access artifacts; expiry/deletion work; logs contain no data or reusable bearer links.
checks.reason: No implementation or test target exists.

checks.procedure: Export a corpus of fields beginning with formula-trigger characters and open/import it in supported spreadsheet clients.
checks.expected: No test value evaluates as a formula; CSV remains syntactically correct and documented semantics are preserved.
checks.reason: No implementation or test target exists.

checks.procedure: Exercise authorized load and abuse cases for duplicate, concurrent, oversized, retried, and canceled exports.
checks.expected: Limits and backpressure protect tenants and dependencies; retries are idempotent and do not duplicate exposure.
checks.reason: No implementation or test target exists; load testing was not authorized.

coverage.rationale: Reviewed tenant and role authorization at each export phase.
Reviewed cross-tenant disclosure and data minimization implications.
Reviewed malicious bulk use and stale privilege.
Identity, scale, alerting, and support processes are undecided.
Reviewed artifact persistence, access, and deletion.
Reviewed request amplification and link reuse.
Queue, retry, cancellation, storage, and incident designs are unavailable.
Reviewed portable artifact disclosure and CSV interpretation.
Reviewed downloadable copies, retention, and sensitive fields.
Reviewed malicious field content and downstream deception.
Supported clients, DLP, audit, retention, and incident procedures are undecided.
